info.syllabusName: Principles of Corporate Finance_Tài chính doanh nghiệp
info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.studentTasks:
'- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance
- Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

materials.materialDescription: Coursera - FPT University Private Authored Courses: How to use financial ratios to evaluate firm’s performance by Excel

materials.author: Robert Parrino, Thomas Bates, Stuart L. Gillan, David S. Kidwell

materials.materialDescription: Fundamentals of Corporate Finance, Asian Edition
materials.author: Robert Parrino, David KidWell

clos.loDetails: Understand the goals of the corporations and roles of financial managers
Understanding of the relationship between risk and return
Understand and employ investment criteria in making investment decisions
Apply different evaluation techniques in pricing bonds and stocks and cash-flow
Using financial analyzing techniques to evaluate a project
Understand techniques to calculate and forecast project cash flows and costs of capital
Apply critical thinking, problem solving, practice ability to work collaboratively within a team and presentation skills to individual and/or group activities dealing with corporate finance
